descriptionChirho: Spatial passage or instrumental agency: moving through a space, or the means/agent by which something is accomplished.
Causal ground or reason for an action or state, indicating the cause that motivates or explains what follows.
Interrogative use asking the cause or reason, typically in the phrase dia ti (διὰ τί).
Inferential or conclusive use pointing back to a previously stated reason, drawing a logical consequence.
Temporal extent indicating duration or continuity through a period of time.
Purpose or benefactive use indicating the goal, purpose, or beneficiary of an action.
Temporal use indicating passage through time to a point after an interval.
